arxiv-2104-13756.title: Distributional Gaussian Process Layers for Outlier Detection in Image Segmentation
arxiv-2104-13756.creator: Sebastian G. Popescu, David J. Sharp, James H. Cole, Konstantinos Kamnitsas, Ben Glocker
arxiv-2104-13756.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sebastian G. Popescu, David J. Sharp, James H. Cole, Konstantinos Kamnitsas, Ben Glocker. We propose a parameter efficient Bayesian layer for hierarchical convolutional Gaussian Processes that incorporates Gaussian Processes operating in Wasserstein-2 space to reliably propagate uncertainty. This directly replaces convolving Gaussian Processes with a distance-preserving affine operator on distributions. Our experiments on brain tissue-segmentation show that the resulting architecture approaches the performance of well-established deterministic segmentation algorithms (U-Net), which has never been achieved with previous hierarchical Gaussian Processes.

arxiv-2112-06438.title: Accelerating BAO Scale Fitting Using Taylor Series 2021 Accelerating BAO Scale Fitting Using Taylor Series – A
arxiv-2112-06438.creator: Matthew T. Hansen, Alex Krolewski, & Zachary Slepian
arxiv-2112-06438.description: Abstract The Universe is currently undergoing accelerated expansion driven by dark energy. Dark energy’s essential nature remains mysterious: one means of revealing it is by measuring the Universe’s size at different redshifts. This may be done using the Baryon Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) feature, a standard ruler in the galaxy 2-Point Correlation Function (2PCF).

arxiv-2301-02999.title: Variational Direct Modeling: A framework towards integration of parametric modeling and direct modeling in CAD Journal: Computer-Aided Design
arxiv-2301-02999.creator: Qiang Zou, Hsi-Yung Feng, Shuming Gao
arxiv-2301-02999.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Qiang Zou, Hsi-Yung Feng, Shuming Gao. Feature-based parametric modeling is the de facto standard in CAD. Boundary representation-based direct modeling is another CAD paradigm developed recently. They have complementary advantages and limitations, thereby offering huge potential for improvement towards an integrated CAD modeling scheme. Most existing integration methods are developed by industry and typically treat direct edits as pseudo-features, where little can be said about seamless integration.

arxiv-2406-02245.title: Description Boosting for Zero-Shot Entity and Relation Classification
arxiv-2406-02245.creator: Gabriele Picco, Leopold Fuchs, Marcos Martinez Galindo, Alberto Purpura, Vanessa Lopez, Hoang Thanh Lam
arxiv-2406-02245.description: Abstract Zero-shot entity and relation classification models leverage available external information of unseen classes - e.g., textual descriptions - to annotate input text data. Thanks to the minimum data requirement, Zero-Shot Learning (ZSL) methods have high value in practice, especially in applications where labeled data is scarce.

arxiv-2411-04184.title: Self-consistent multidimensional Penrose process driven by magnetic reconnection
arxiv-2411-04184.creator: Filippo Camilloni, Luciano Rezzolla
arxiv-2411-04184.description: Abstract Astronomical observations and numerical simulations are providing increasing evidence that resistive effects in plasmas around black holes play an important role in determining the phenomenology observed from these objects. In this spirit, we present a general approach to the study of a Penrose process driven by plasmoids that are produced at reconnection sites along current sheets.

arxiv-2508-12030.title: Means of Random Variables in Lie Groups Thanks: Submitted on July 11, 2025
arxiv-2508-12030.creator: Shiraz Khan, Jikai Ye, Gregory S. Chirikjian
arxiv-2508-12030.description: Abstract The concepts of mean (i.e., average) and covariance of a random variable are fundamental in statistics, and are used to solve real-world problems such as those that arise in robotics, computer vision, and medical imaging. On matrix Lie groups, multiple competing definitions of the mean arise, including the Euclidean, projected, distance-based (i.e., Fréchet and Karcher), group-theoretic, and parametric means.

arxiv-2509-14198.title: A Variational Framework for Residual-Based Adaptivity in Neural PDE Solvers and Operator Learning Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2509-14198.creator: Juan Diego Toscano, Daniel T. Chen, Vivek Oommen, Jérôme Darbon, George Em Karniadakis
arxiv-2509-14198.description: Abstract Residual-based adaptive strategies are widely used in scientific machine learning but remain largely heuristic. We introduce a unifying variational framework that formalizes these methods by integrating convex transformations of the residual. Different transformations correspond to distinct objective functionals: exponential weights target the minimization of uniform error, while linear weights recover the minimization of quadratic error.

arxiv-2512-10950.title: E -RayZer: Self-supervised 3D Reconstruction as Spatial Visual Pre-training
arxiv-2512-10950.creator: Qitao Zhao Hao Tan Qianqian Wang Sai Bi, Kai Zhang Kalyan Sunkavalli Shubham Tulsiani Hanwen Jiang
arxiv-2512-10950.description: Abstract Self-supervised pre-training has revolutionized foundation models for languages, individual 2D images and videos, but remains largely unexplored for learning 3D-aware representations from multi-view images. In this paper, we present E-RayZer, a self-supervised large 3D Vision model that learns truly 3D-aware representations directly from unlabeled images.

britannica-1911-tasso-torquato.title: Tasso, Torquato (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tasso-torquato.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tasso-torquato.description: Article 'Tasso, Torquato' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Bernardo Tasso (1493–1569), a nobleman of Bergamo, and his wife Porzia de’ Rossi. He was born at Sorrento on the 11th of March 1544. His father had for many years been secretary in the service of the prince of Salerno, and his mother was closely connected with the most illustrious Neapolitan families.

pmc-12578221.title: Failure characteristics of unsaturated intact loess under different hydraulic pathways
pmc-12578221.creator: Weiye Fu, Shengjun Shao, Aizhong Luo, Tao Li, Zijun Zhao
pmc-12578221.description: This study systematically investigates the effects of two hydraulic pathways—wetting followed by loading (W-L) and loading followed by wetting (L-W)—on the water retention and strength characteristics of intact loess from a Xi’an metro line. Using an improved unsaturated triaxial testing system, experiments were conducted under controlled suction, net confining pressure, and shear stress levels.

pmc-12608708.title: Green-Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles from Garlic Peel Target NF-κB and Redox Imbalance: A Novel Therapeutic Strategy Against Pyrogallol-Induced Hepatotoxicity in Rats
pmc-12608708.creator: Duaa A. Althumairy
pmc-12608708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Hepatotoxicity remains a major therapeutic challenge driven by oxidative stress and inflammation. This study investigated the hepatoprotective potential of green-synthesized silver nanoparticles derived from ethanolic garlic peel extract (GPE-Ag) against pyrogallol-induced liver injury. Methods: Adult rats were randomly assigned into four groups: a control group, a pyrogallol-treated group, a group receiving GPE-Ag nanoparticles (50 mg/kg, orally) for 28 days, and GPE-Ag + pyrogallol co-treated.

pmc-12612772.title: Multicentre phase II open study assessing the efficacy and safety of apremilast in children and adults with epidermolysis bullosa simplex generalised: study protocol for the EBULO study
pmc-12612772.creator: Eric Fontas, Thomas Hubiche, Annabel Maruani, Ruxanda Moschoi, Sagair Hussain, Christine Chiaverini
pmc-12612772.description: IntroductionEpidermolysis bullosa (EB) is a group of rare genetic skin disorders characterised by skin and mucosal fragility, leading to painful blisters and erosions. Among its subtypes, the severe form of EB simplex (EBS-sev, OMIM 131760) is associated with widespread blistering from birth, mucosal involvement and increased neonatal mortality due to infections.

pmc-12655409.title: Healthcare Professionals’ Perceptions of Anhedonia in Major Depressive Disorder and the Possibilities of Episodic Future Thinking Training: A Qualitative Study in a Tertiary Care Hospital
pmc-12655409.creator: Minghao Pan, Huijing Zou, Dan Luo, Xiao Qin Wang, Qian Liu, Meiyu Shen, Xiaofen Li, Xuan Gong, Bing Xiang Yang, Daniel Bressington
pmc-12655409.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a mental disorder with a high prevalence rate and a high recurrence rate. Therefore, identifying and intervening in the core symptoms of MDD patients is of great significance. Anhedonia is manifested as an individual losing interest in activities or experiencing a significant decrease in the sense of pleasure, which is one of the two core symptoms of MDD.

pmc-13159179.title: Evaluating the implementation of integrated knowledge translation in a multi-country research consortium in Sub-Saharan Africa – a mixed methods comparative case study
pmc-13159179.creator: Kerstin Sell, Eva Rehfuess, Esther Bayiga-Zziwa, Jimmy Osuret, Lisa Pfadenhauer
pmc-13159179.description: BackgroundIntegrated knowledge translation (IKT) is an approach facilitating collaboration between researchers and decision-makers towards evidence-informed decision-making. Increasingly evaluated in various contexts, less is known about the implementation process of IKT, including in low- and middle-income countries. The Collaboration for Evidence-based Healthcare and Public Health in Africa (CEBHA+) developed, implemented and evaluated an IKT approach across five countries.
